title: GAO Report on the Navy’s Shipyard Infrastructure Optimization Program
summary: The following is the Sept. 25, 2026, Government Accountability Office report, Naval Shipyards: Complete Information Needed for Decision-Making on Multibillion-Dollar, 50-Year Infrastructure Program. From the Report The Navy is taking on its largest-ever construction and restoration effort to improve poor conditions and outdated infrastructure at its 4 shipyards. These shipyards are essential to ensuring the Navy’s aircraft carriers and submarines are fit to fight in operations. This effort could take over 50 years and ultimately cost more than $200 billion. But we found that Navy and congressional oversight requirements don’t include regular evaluation of costs, risks, and performance for this
